plan.name: Retry TLC's wrapped memory failures
plan.summary: Recognize OutOfMemoryError reported as the cause of TLC's wrapped exception, including message 1000 with the cause on a separate colon-prefixed line and either GC overhead limit exceeded or Java heap space, as confirmed memory exhaustion. Give these reports the existing single exclusive retry with more memory when eligible, preserving both attempts in history and discarding unfinished model evidence. Preserve existing diagnostic forms, retry limits, allocation and deadline rules, and ordinary results for module names, action names, trace values and unrelated exceptions containing similar text. Update docs/gate.md's TLC resource budget section to describe the recognized reports and the distinction from model output. This implements the memory policy in D-0315 and D-0322; the merger records the diagnostic-recognition decision for issue #552 because the plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestTLC552WrappedMemoryReportsAndModelText
tests.says: TLC's wrapped GC-overhead and Java-heap causes are named memory failures without partial model evidence; module and action names, trace values and unrelated wrapped exceptions keep their ordinary results and never earn a memory retry.

tests.name: TestTLC552WrappedMemoryRetryHistory
tests.says: Each wrapped memory cause earns exactly one larger retry with the same check configuration, and history retains both allocations and outcomes whether the retry recovers or exhausts memory again.

tests.name: TestTLC552WrappedMemoryRetryRunsAlone
tests.says: A wrapped memory failure enters the existing exclusive retry path: another check sharing a budget with multiple ordinary slots cannot start while that retry runs, and can run once it finishes.

usage.summary: Wrote [plan.json](plan.json) and three acceptance tests covering wrapped memory failures, exclusive retries, history, and false positives. Check 1 passed: all three tests fail on the base code, and `repo/` remains unchanged.
